parameters.content:
## OPS.SLK-A · Team Onboarding Intake

n8n Form → normalize → **upsert** `team_members` (LP Supabase, on conflict email) → invite email (Gmail, updates@reecewindowsmail.com) → `#ops-alerts`.

**This is an n8n Form on purpose.** Employees must never become GHL contacts, so this never touches GHL. The row it writes is what OPS.SLK-B matches on when the person joins Slack — the email they sign up with must be the one entered here.

**Idempotent.** Submitting the same email twice updates the row (name, phone, market, role, status back to `invited`) and re-sends the invite. It never creates a duplicate.

**Env (n8n main instance):** `LP_SUPABASE_URL`, `LP_SUPABASE_KEY` (already set), `SLACK_INVITE_URL`, `SLACK_OPS_ALERTS_CHANNEL_ID`, `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`.

**Reading a red execution:** Upsert red = table missing or key wrong (run the SQL / check LP_SUPABASE_KEY). Email red = Gmail credential expired. Check Slack Response red = token / channel id / scope problem, and the message tells you which.

**Normalize** is a verbatim copy of `scripts/lib/slack-onboarding-normalize.js`; `node --test scripts/test-slack-onboarding.js` fails if they drift.

parameters.formDescription: Fill this in once per new team member. They get a Slack invite by email and their channels are set up automatically when they join. Use the COMPANY email they will sign up to Slack with.

values.formSubmittedText: Check your email for your Slack invite.

nodes.name: Upsert team_members

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name, email: $json.email, phone: $json.phone, market_code: $json.market_code, role: $json.role, status: 'invited' }) }}

nodes.notes: PostgREST upsert keyed on the email UNIQUE constraint. slack_user_id / rep_channel_id are not in the body, so a re-submit never wipes a provisioned person's Slack ids. Red here = table missing (run sql/slack_onboarding_schema.sql) or LP_SUPABASE_KEY is not the service_role key (RLS is on).

nodes.name: Send Slack Invite Email

parameters.subject: Welcome to Reece — join Slack

nodes.notes: Plain-text on purpose — one link, one instruction. SLACK_INVITE_URL is the no-expiry shareable invite from Slack → Settings & administration → Invitations.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $env.SLACK_OPS_ALERTS_CHANNEL_ID, text: '🟢 ONBOARDING · ' + $('Normalize').first().json.first_name + ' ' + $('Normalize').first().json.last_name + ' · ' + $('Normalize').first().json.role + ' · ' + ($('Normalize').first().json.market_code || 'company-wide') + ' · invite sent to ' + $('Normalize').first().json.email }) }}

meta.note: Ships INACTIVE. Activate after sql/slack_onboarding_schema.sql (3 executions) has run and SLACK_INVITE_URL / SLACK_OPS_ALERTS_CHANNEL_ID / SLACK_BOT_TOKEN are set on the n8n Railway service. The form is public at /form/team-onboarding — share the link only internally. See workflows/README-slack-onboarding.md.
